Performance of a 12.5 kW Magnetically Shielded Hall Thruster on Krypton

Document Type
Conference Paper

Abstract

We report thrust, specific impulse and anode efficiency of a 12.5 kW magnetically shielded Hall thruster operated on krypton across discharge voltages from 300 to 600 V. We measure electron temperature and density across the operating map of a laboratory thruster and fit a reduced kinetic model to the data.
